candidates.title: Replit makes OpenAI its default over Anthropic, CEO says
candidates.summary: Over the weekend, Masad clarified that OpenAI would replace Anthropic as its default model provider. Claude will still be available to customers on the platform.

candidates.title: Meta removes language that raised scraping and AI training concerns
candidates.summary: A Meta spokesperson insisted that the updated terms did not reflect a change in the way Meta crawls the web.
